bead.title: claude-tui/gate: capture /usage deltas for PTY+hooks mode (3 runs)
bead.description:
PROBLEM: ADR-013's economic premise asserts PTY+hooks-driven Claude consumes subscription quota. No empirical /usage deltas have been captured for PTY mode, so the subscription-consumption claim is unverified.

ROOT CAUSE: docs/helix/02-design/billing-observation-claude-tui.md has an empty 'PTY+hooks mode measurements' placeholder; no /usage snapshots exist for this mode.

PROPOSED FIX: Using the same model, prompt, account, and refresh-delay defined in the methodology doc (and the same authenticated account used for --print measurements), drive Claude via the PTY+hooks harness three times. For each run capture: /usage snapshot BEFORE, full turn output, /usage snapshot AFTER (>=60s post-completion). Append all 6 /usage snapshots + 3 turn outputs to the 'PTY+hooks mode measurements' section of docs/helix/02-design/billing-observation-claude-tui.md. Record wall-clock timestamps. Ensure no overlap with the --print measurement window.

NON-SCOPE: --print measurements, delta computation, verdict determination, ADR-013 disposition, methodology authoring.

AC:
1) TestPtyModeHasThreeRuns: doc's PTY+hooks section contains exactly 3 labeled runs.
2) TestPtyModeBeforeAfterSnapshots: each PTY run has BEFORE and AFTER /usage snapshot blocks (6 total).
3) TestPtyModeTurnOutputsRecorded: each PTY run has captured turn output.
4) TestPtyModeSnapshotTimestamps: every snapshot has a wall-clock timestamp.
5) TestPtyModeAfterRespectsRefreshDelay: each AFTER snapshot timestamp is >= completion-time + documented refresh-delay safety margin.
6) TestPtyModeSingleAccountAttested: doc attests no concurrent claude activity from same account during the PTY window AND windows do not overlap --print window.

GATES: `go test ./...` passes; `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
bead.acceptance:
1) TestPtyModeHasThreeRuns
2) TestPtyModeBeforeAfterSnapshots
3) TestPtyModeTurnOutputsRecorded
4) TestPtyModeSnapshotTimestamps
5) TestPtyModeAfterRespectsRefreshDelay
6) TestPtyModeSingleAccountAttested
Gates: `go test ./...`, `lefthook run pre-commit`.
